segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin mostly report good results, including no breakouts and skin that is less oily by the end of the day; a couple, however, note uncertainty about how well the rich, thick texture suits very oily skin.
segments.dry: The large majority of reviewers with dry to very dry skin, including some with flaking, report deep, lasting hydration that often holds up overnight; one reviewer (3 stars), however, found the texture more gel-like than a true cream and says explicitly it is not suited to dry skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it helps hydrate the drier areas of their face without feeling too rich; one reviewer finds it a bit heavy for her personally.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive, reactive, or tretinoin-irritated skin report the cream is calming and non-irritating. One reviewer, however, reports waking up with red, dry skin resembling an allergic reaction and warns sensitive-skin users to be careful.

concerns.dehydration: The overwhelming majority of reviewers, across dry, oily, and sensitive skin alike, report deep, long-lasting hydration that holds up overnight or through harsh winter conditions, several saying it outperformed thicker or pricier creams they had tried. One reviewer, however, found the texture more gel-like than expected and reports her skin still felt a little dry.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the cream reduces redness and calms irritated skin, including after harsh winter weather or acid and retinoid use. Two reviewers, however, report the opposite: one woke up with red, dry skin resembling an allergic reaction, and another developed redness around her nose and cheeks that she attributes to a fungal-acne reaction, possibly from the shea butter.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers specifically credit the cream with repairing or supporting their skin barrier, including one who says her barrier healed within two days and another who uses it as a barrier cream on a child's eczema.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers with acne-prone skin report no breakouts, clearer skin, and unclogged pores, several specifically noting they usually break out from new products but did not with this one. One reviewer, however, reports the opposite: pimples and redness she attributes to a fungal-acne reaction, likely from the shea butter in the formula.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers, including some with oily or acne-prone skin, report the cream absorbs without leaving an oily or greasy finish, and a couple specifically say it left their skin less oily by the end of the day than other moisturizers; no reviewer in this set reports it making their skin oilier.

extraits.texte: I really wanted to like this cream and was so excited to use it. I put it on at night and in the night I had trouble sleeping because my face and neck were slightly itchy, but it wasn't too bad. The next morning I woke up with my skin around my eyes red and dry, looking similar to when I have an allergic reaction. The cream is very thick and unscented and feels nourishing but it reacted very poorly with my skin. Be careful if you have sensitive skin.
